title: Counting to 10 on a ten frame
examples: How do I use a ten frame?
How many counters fill a ten frame?
How can I count without losing my place?

explain.say: Imagine an egg box with exactly 10 cups. That is a ten frame! Look at the board. There are 2 rows of 5 boxes, and each box holds 1 counter. All 10 boxes are full.

draw.text: Counting to 10 on a ten frame

explain.say: Let us start small. Point at each counter and say one number: 1, 2, 3. See the 3 counters? Each one gets just one number. How many boxes are still empty?
Now look. 5 counters fill the whole top row. Here is a trick: a full row is always 5, so you do not need to count them one by one. Can you see the empty bottom row?
Here are 8 counters. The top row is full, that is 5, and the bottom row has 3. So 5 and 3 make 8. How many more would fill the frame?
Well done! Every box is full again, so you have 10. In Japan, children use an abacus called a soroban, with one bead worth 5, just like a full row. Can you show 7 on your fingers with one whole hand?

faq.a: A ten frame is a box with 2 rows of 5 spaces. You put one counter in each space, so a full frame always shows 10.
asks: Why is it called a ten frame?

faq.q: Why does a ten frame have rows of five?
faq.a: Five is easy to see at a glance, like one hand of fingers. When the top row is full, you know it is 5 without counting.

faq.q: How do I count without missing one?
faq.a: Point at each thing once and say one number for it. Move each counted thing to one side, so you never count it twice.
asks: How can I count without losing my place?

faq.a: Count the empty boxes on the ten frame. If 8 boxes are full, 2 are empty, so 2 more make 10.
After 10 comes 11. You fill one whole frame and put 1 counter on a new frame, so 11 is ten and one more.
asks: What if I have more than 10 counters?

facts: A ten frame has 10 spaces in 2 rows of 5.
The Japanese soroban abacus has one bead worth 5 above four beads worth 1 in each column.

quiz.say: The top row of a ten frame is full. How many counters is that?
quiz.show: The top row of a ten frame is full. How many counters is that?
quiz.why: Each row of a ten frame has 5 spaces, so a full top row is 5.

wrong.0: 10 is the whole frame, with both rows full.
wrong.2: 4 is one short; a row has 5 spaces.

quiz.say: A ten frame has 6 counters. How many boxes are empty?
quiz.show: A ten frame has 6 counters. How many boxes are empty?
quiz.why: 6 and 4 make 10, so 4 boxes are empty.

wrong.0: 6 is the number of counters, not the empty boxes.
wrong.1: 5 empty boxes would mean only 5 counters.
